/narrative.1: Within the framework of the PRSP, the programme aims to reduce, in a sustainable manner, the high incidence of poverty among rural populations in the five oasis regions. The proposed eight year programme will pursue this goal through: (i) the development of grass-roots organizations of the target populations; (ii) the promotion of sustainable oasis agricultural systems through the development and dissemination of appropriate technical and managerial know-how and through marketing support; (iii) financial support for essential community-based social and economic infrastructure; and (iv) the consolidation of viable decentralized rural finance systems.
